body:
**Dive into a unique Minecraft world where style meets magic! Introducing the PinkGlasses plugin, inspired by the iconic pink glasses of Garett the Scavenger from the upcoming Minecraft movie** 🎬

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/062784d76472bca28bc261adfe9c6348d59d8f2e.jpeg)

# 🧪 Features

## 🕶️ Style and Power Combined:
- Put on the pink glasses (/pinkglasses puton) and feel an instant surge of power with the Resistance effect! 
- Easily take off the glasses (/pinkglasses takeoff) when you feel strong enough!
## 👑 Full Control for Administrators:
- Grant players the right to use the glasses (/pgadmin add <player>) and bestow unique abilities! 🌟
- Revoke rights (/pgadmin remove <player>) to maintain balance on the server! ⚖️
